quarterly_data.quarter: Resonac (Showa Denko) press release: Notice Concerning Transfer of Adhesives Businesses of (10-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Resonac signed definitive agreements to transfer parts of its adhesives businesses to the Sika Group: the adhesives (excluding tape) and hot-melt businesses at its Goi Plant (Noda) in Japan, all operations of the Dapumei Plant of Resonac Li-Bond Materials (Taiwan) plus its polyurethane and epoxy adhesive businesses at the Minxiong Plant, and all operations of Resonac Li-Bond Materials (Wuxi) in China; the tape and low-melting glass businesses in Japan and certain Taiwan adhesive products are excluded. Completion is scheduled during 2027, subject to conditions, and the impact on consolidated results is expected to be immaterial.
